typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		AMOUNT as double,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		VERSION_NUM as decimal(38,0),
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		ENTITY_FIELD_NAME as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp,
		ENTITY_CLASS_NAME as string,
		OLD_VALUE as string,
		NEW_VALUE as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		FIELD_TYPE as string,
		ALLOW_UNDO_B as decimal(38,0),
		AUDIT_ACTION as string,
		OBJECT_VALUE as string,
		SMALL_OBJECT_VALUE as string,
		ENTITY_NAME as string,
		RELATED_ID as decimal(38,0),
		COMPRESSED_B as decimal(38,0),
		PO_ID as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of MODIF_DATE} = toDate(MODIF_DATE, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LOAD_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ENTITY_ID as integer,
		ALLOW_UNDO_B as integer,
		RELATED_ID as integer,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		SMALL_OBJECT_VALUE as string,
		COMPRESSED_B as integer,
		USER_NAME as string,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		ENTITY_FIELD_NAME as string,
		OLD_VALUE as string,
		FIELD_TYPE as string,
		NEW_VALUE as string,
		OBJECT_VALUE as string,
		AMOUNT as integer,
		PO_ID as integer,
		MODIF_DATE as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		ENTITY_CLASS_NAME as string,
		AUDIT_ACTION as string,
		ENTITY_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LOAD_DATE = LoadDate,
		ENTITY_ID,
		ALLOW_UNDO_B,
		RELATED_ID,
		VERSION_NUM,
		SMALL_OBJECT_VALUE,
		COMPRESSED_B,
		USER_NAME,
		VALUE_DATE,
		SHORT_NAME,
		ENTITY_FIELD_NAME,
		OLD_VALUE,
		FIELD_TYPE,
		NEW_VALUE,
		OBJECT_VALUE,
		AMOUNT,
		PO_ID,
		MODIF_DATE = {Copy of MODIF_DATE},
		TRADE_ID,
		ENTITY_CLASS_NAME,
		AUDIT_ACTION,
		ENTITY_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
